notes.title: Full Release - 1.0.0
notes.content:
Thank you!

I just wanted to take a second to thank everyone who took the time to download and play Let's Pet Pets in Early Access. I had a great time making LPP the best pet petting experience possible with your help and I hope that everyone enjoyed coming along for the ride.

The game is now out of Early Access and I will continue to push updates to fix bugs, balance, and make other changes that will improve the experience. If you have any questions, comments, or requests please reach out in the community tab or on the community discord. Thank you all for everything!

notes.title: Early Access - 0.1.8 - Goodbye Town
notes.content:
Goodbye Town
It was a hard decision to make, but the town building system took up too much development time to release consistent updates to the game. It was a cool idea, but it was not fleshed out enough to be anything more than a glorified menu for unlocking new pet groups.

Pet groups will now be automatically unlocked simply by ascending. I know that this decision will upset some of you who have grown fond of your little pet town, but in order to continue creating the best pet petting experience possible it was important for me to re-evaluate the games core features and cut the fat.

Other things

 Performance improvements
 Added milestones for combos

notes.title: Early Access - 0.0.8 - Quests and Balancing
notes.content:
New Features

 Added new quest regarding leveling up pets


Balancing

 Pet levels will now be based on factors of 2 instead of stepped 5s. This should make leveling pets easier.
[olist]
 Level 2: 5 -> 2
 Level 3: 10 -> 4
 Level 4: 25 -> 8
 Level 5: 50 -> 16
 Level 6: 100 -> 32
 Level 7: 250 -> 64
 Level 8: 500 -> 128
 Level 9: 1000 -> 256
 Level 10: 2500 -> 512
 Level MAX: 5000 -> 1024
[/olist]


Bug Fixes

 Quest list will now refresh automatically when switching pets, gaining heart points, etc.


Quality of Life

 Quest list will display quests for all pets, not just the active one. Sorting order has been changed.
[olist]
 Completed Quests
 Current Pet Quests
 Global Quests
 Other Pet Quests (Based on Corral Order)
 Completed Quests
[/olist]

notes.title: Early Access - 0.0.3 - Day/Night, Nicknames, and New Legendary Pet
notes.content:
Thank you to the community for sticking with me
I have been trying to figure out why there is no Add to Cart or Buy option on the Steam store for Let's Pet Pets. I have contacted support and am waiting eagerly to hear back from them to resolve this issue. In the meantime please join the Discord server and let me know what you want to see in future updates.

New Features


 Added a Day/Night cycle to the game (Based on Realtime)
 Pets can now have an affinity for certain times of day (increasing pet point production)
 Added ability to rename pets as suggested by DarkestDemon on Discord
 Added a new Legendary dog as a pet in honor of the curator Can You Pet the Dog
